name: the-advisor
description: Second-opinion layer for Claude Code: a cheap workhorse model is obligated to consult a stronger advisor model before architectural or hard-to-reverse decisions. The advisor can be any provider — Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, or a local model via any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — chosen by config, not code.

advisor_model.title: Advisor model
advisor_model.description: The strongest model you have access to. Examples: claude-opus-5, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gpt-5.6, gemma3:latest. Must be a name your provider accepts — see the model-name links in the README.

advisor_provider.title: Advisor provider
advisor_provider.description: One of: anthropic-cli, gemini-cli, anthropic-api, openai-api, openai-compatible. The *-cli options bill your existing subscription.

advisor_base_url.title: Advisor base URL
advisor_base_url.description: Only for local models or gateways, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for ollama. Leave blank for Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI.

advisor_api_key.title: Advisor API key
advisor_api_key.description: Only for the *-api providers. Leave blank to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY from your shell instead.
